name: Holiday plan
summary: Get through the holiday season with week-by-week tasks for events, gifts and budget through December 31.

onboarding.prompt: Which events are you planning for?

plan_blueprint.calendar: Weekly planning slots, shipping deadlines, event dates, and a rest day after the big ones, ending December 31. Weeks are counted back from December 31.

approach_variants.habit: One small holiday task a day, stacked on morning coffee; streak of task days.
approach_variants.willpower: Challenge: all gifts bought by a date you pick, with a countdown.
approach_variants.time: Every task and shipping deadline is a calendar block; weekly time review.
approach_variants.reward: Owner-chosen treat when gifts are done and a rest day after the big event.
approach_variants.resource: First week gathers addresses, wrapping supplies, recipes and the budget split.

guardrails: Budget figures stay private by default.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
Product, app or recipe ideas are labeled as suggestions; any affiliate link is disclosed.
restart_rules: Missed tasks roll forward; tasks with deadlines (shipping, bookings) move to the top.
addon_tracks: Suggested: Finish the Year Reset Track

price_log.basis: Launch proposal per docs/MARKETPLACE.md; pending owner approval
